name: dsh-window-size-keeper
description: Keeps the DSH desktop window the size you left it: records the main window's last outer frame in physical pixels and restores it (centred) on the next start, with a bilingual Settings → Window size section offering 12 common resolutions and custom width/height that apply immediately. Win32 P/Invoke through powershell.exe, zero external dependencies.
author: ecbob

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check scripts/selftest.mjs && node --check scripts/check-sensitive.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run scan:sensitive && node scripts/selftest.mjs
